resource_lifetime.rationale: The pure tunnel owner is bounded by profile limits, scopes owner events by session/generation/tunnel, rejects terminal reversal, and closes every nonterminal entry; deterministic 1/10/50 cleanup passes. One shared runner owns at most 50 active leases and 256 audits. Production keeps zero managed children/listeners while activation is false; native forced descendant cleanup and sustained resources remain external.

storage_hygiene.rationale: Only provider-neutral completion receipts are queued off the runner hot path and stored atomically with private permissions, no-follow identity checks, primary/previous recovery, 256-record and 2-MiB ceilings; destinations, terminal text, credentials, executable paths, and digests are excluded.

resilience.rationale: Preparation invalidates on owned revisions; hostile input and stale scope fail closed. Runner capacity, pre-publication completion, failed publication, route close, revocation, and shutdown have fixed redacted recovery and exact cleanup ownership.

visual_quality.rationale: The renderer uses compact icon-labelled Connection, Safety, and Launch cards, adds redundant icon/color/text tunnel state, disables strong-tunnel session grants, wraps complete trust evidence, and keeps approval/copy/editor hit targets non-overlapping. Renderer-neutral geometry passes tiny-to-8K-equivalent cases; controlled native pixel review remains external.
